name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> form: 'chapter_01' is the domain (01 = chapter ID 1, a meaningful game-domain ID that must be preserved), 'end' is the descriptor (chapter-end handler). No Ghidra address residue. Name accurately reflects role as the chapter 1 end handler dispatched from the chapter-end pointer table @ 0x51DE9 slot 0.
purpose: Chapter 1 (初試身手) end handler: show the chapter-end dialog, persist party state to the template store, and set the current-chapter id so the engine advances to the next chapter.
logic_summary: Body: (1) __CHK(0x28) Watcom stack-probe (frame size 0x28). (2) fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=9, 0xa0000, 0x140, 0xcd, 0x4c, 0x4a, 0x13, 1) -- render chapter-end dialog page 9 to the VGA back buffer. (3) fd2_save_runtime_char_to_template() -- persist runtime-character state back to the template store. (4) MOV dword [0x53c03], 0x1 -- write literal 1 to data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id (the engine's next-chapter index). Distinct from sibling end handlers which INC the id; chapter 1 assigns it directly. No char recruited here (戰士哈諾 joins via an in-battle FDFIELD event). Straight-line, single basic block, no branches.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects only: renders dialog, persists party template, sets current_chapter_id = 1.

reads_globals: data_fd2_current_chapter_text (@0x53A79) -- chapter text/dialog table base, passed to fd2_display_dialog_scene

Also clarified that no char is recruited in the handler (戰士哈諾 joins via an in-battle FDFIELD event).
